copy.tagline: 用事件建模设计系统，理清业务事件流
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要用事件流来规划和设计系统
copy.tagline_en: Design systems by modeling business events
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to plan and design systems using event flows

howto.what: Claude会引导你通过对话逐步设计系统的事件模型，生成一组用业务语言描述的独立可实现的切片，包括状态变更、视图和自动化操作。对于已有代码，它能分析并提取领域概念。
howto.when: 当你需要设计一个新系统的事件模型，或者想分析现有代码提取事件模型时，可以启用这个技能。它会引导你完成领域理解、高层模型、细节切片和可执行规范。

say.text: 帮我设计一个在线书店系统的事件模型
say.note: Claude会按阶段从领域理解到详细切片进行引导

say.text: 分析现有代码库，提取事件模型
say.note: 它会读取代码并映射到状态变更、视图等切片

howto.what_en: Guides you through a conversational process to design an event model for a system. Produces vertical slices (state changes, views, automation) using business language. Can also analyze existing codebases to extract domain concepts.
howto.when_en: Use when you need to design an event model for a new system or extract one from existing code. It walks through domain understanding, high-level model, slice details, and specs.

say_en.text: Design an event model for an online bookstore system.
say_en.note: It will guide you through phases from domain to detailed slices.

say_en.text: Analyze the existing codebase and extract the event model.
say_en.note: It reads code and maps to state changes, views, etc.
